headline: 🚨 cPanel 40K Servers Compromised, 🎓 Instructure 275M Records Breached, 💻 FreeBSD DHCP Root RCE, 🛡️ Microsoft Defender DigiCert False Positive, 📧 Teams Phishing 72% Success, 📦 MOVEit Auth Bypass
summary: CISA adds cPanel CVE-2026-41940 to KEV as 40,000+ servers are confirmed compromised in targeted government and military attacks. Instructure confirms data breach with ShinyHunters claiming 275M records. New FreeBSD DHCP client RCE grants root access. MOVEit Automation patched for auth bypass and privilege escalation flaws.
